transcript: Okay. What? My mouth is watering. Like you have a craving or something? Yes. Okay, tell me about it. Okay, I want sugar sliders. What is that, like a sweet burger or something? Ew. What? Why would you think that? Rice Krispie Treats, that's the bun. They have to be homemade because they have to be gooey. What? Then you take Nutella, that's like the mayo, strawberries. Is that like the tomato? Yes. Following the Reese's Cup. As the meat? As the meat. Ooh, and then caramel drizzle on top. Doesn't that sound good? It does sound a little good. You want me to make that right now? Yes. Okay, fine, I'll go get the stuff. All right, I tried my best. Sugar sliders. Oh my. Is it how you imagined? It's better. What? It's good? What is that? What is that face? My belly's about to hurt.
metadata_caption: I’m always anxiously waiting for her reaction to see if it’s good or bad! 😂 I don’t know where Kay comes up with these cravings, but it always tastes so good! She literally will come bursting out of the most random places talking about her cravings! 😂 She should really write a cookbook or something! 🤔 Also, she ended up not having a stomach ache so thats good! 😅 Oh! and if you are new to our pregnancy journey, we have a lot of other cravings and experiences on our page! 😁 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
